slots.date: required ISO date or resolved relative date
slots.unit_cost_rub: optional user input; no default; 250 only when user supplies 250
slots.tax: optional user rule/base/rate; absent -> excluded and stated
slots.own_costs: optional user input; absent -> excluded and stated

answer_contract.currency_policy: RUB or separate currency groups; never mix currencies
answer_contract.completeness: A report with estimates is forecast; missing required advertising or expense scope -> PARTIAL with exact reason, no final net profit
tables: A: counterfactual all ordered items fulfilled, no cancellations/returns
B: current order cohort including cancellation/return losses
answer_contract.unit_cost_display: user input stays 250 per applicable goods item if input250; allocated cost per all ordered items is separate and must not be relabelled as unit purchase cost

expressions: N_ordered = SUM(original products.quantity), before removing cancellations; not COUNT(sales)
V_all = SUM(seller order unit_price * quantity); buyer discounted payment is a different metric
V_remaining = V_all - cancelled seller value - qualified returned seller value
row_percent = expense_total / seller_value_of_same_scenario * 100; zero denominator -> not defined, not zero
goods_cost = user_unit_cost * applicable_remaining_ordered_quantity; cancellation revenue=0 and cancellation goods_cost=0
result = seller_value - unique marketplace expenses - advertising - included goods_cost - included own_costs - included tax
rub_per_item = row_total / explicitly printed scenario quantity; do not replace order cohort with day financial sales count
cohort = order_feed.data.orders filtered by createdAt in requested Moscow calendar date; one unique srid = one item
seller_value = SUM(cohort.sellerPrice); not finishedPrice, not rounded funnel orderSum, not forPay
forward_mean = SUM(deliveryService where deliveryAmount>0 and returnAmount=0) / SUM(deliveryAmount), within declared scheme/profile; apply to ordered units as estimate
reverse_mean = SUM(deliveryService where deliveryAmount=0 and returnAmount>0) / SUM(returnAmount), within declared scheme/profile; apply to cancelled units if stage unknown and no exact tariff
bank_mean = SUM(acquiringFee on qualified sale rows)/SUM(quantity on those sale rows); apply only with printed category, sample count, payment/scheme transfer caveat
ads = SUM(updSum), with date/currency/paymentType validation, all campaign statuses; not budget deposits
all_store_overhead is allocated once per period and scope; a matched cohort expense already inside it is not added twice
negative_cases: one partially cancelled child does not duplicate original
delivery total + its components not added twice
finance ads + Performance ads not added twice
unknown cancel stage -> return tariff without manual block
429/missing ads yields reason, not blank answer
supplier/orders incomplete while order-feed and funnel contain more orders
order-feed selectedPeriod is current status time, not createdAt; querying only one status day misses changed orders
funnel rounded orderSum must not overwrite decimal sellerPrice sum
FBW paidStorageKgvp must not be replaced by kgvpSupplier (DBS)
forPay already net: do not subtract commission/acquiring a second time
deliveryAmount0 quantity0 fee row is valid and must not disappear
negative commission/payment corrections retain source signs
return-to-seller tariff is not buyer-return-to-WB tariff
no matching warehouse: do not pick the first row or average all warehouse tariffs
truncated cards page is not full catalog; exact required product lookup can establish needed dimensions

order-cohort outcomes as of refresh; orderSum may be rounded. No sale-event denominator substitution.

source_bindings.join: srid exact original item, optionally qualified orderUid; nmId alone is not an order join
source_bindings.signs: Decode operation and field meanings; negative commission/credits are not clipped to zero; forPay must not be charged commission/acquiring twice

exact_fallbacks.commission: Use matched source actual when complete; otherwise base rate from exact category and FBW/FBS field times sellerPrice; label current tariff forecast. If no category or scheme -> missing_commission_binding, not global percent.
exact_fallbacks.forward_logistics: Matched delivery actual first. Otherwise exact applicable WB tariff with verified formula. If warehouse/tariff cannot be bound, use SUM(deliveryService)/SUM(deliveryAmount) for forward-only rows in same scheme and dimensions profile. Print category-transfer scope and sample size; no whole-warehouse average.
exact_fallbacks.unknown_cancellation_stage: Include buyer reverse-transport estimate per cancelled unit: exact matched reverse charge/reversal first, then applicable WB buyer-return tariff, otherwise reverse-only observed mean SUM(deliveryService)/SUM(returnAmount) in declared scheme/profile. If none exists, return explicit missing_reverse_cost with source/field/reason. Never copy Ozon return_flow_amount or the Ozon monetary values.
exact_fallbacks.return_events: deliveryAmount and returnAmount classify financial transportation events; they do not by themselves prove an order cancellation date. Keep cancellation/nonbuyout/customer return/return-to-seller separate.
exact_fallbacks.bank: Exact matched acquiringFee first; otherwise qualified same-category observed fee per sale quantity with sample date/count. Scheme/payment mix transfer must be explicit; no inferred universal percentage.
exact_fallbacks.period_overhead: Sum paidStorage, paidAcceptance, rebillLogisticCost, deductions, penalties and other decoded cost types for store-period; assign only once, state cohort allocation and prevent overlaps with item-linked actuals. Unreconciled nested field stays a named completeness gap, not automatic double charge.
exact_fallbacks.future_adjustments: Fresh orders are a fulfillment forecast. Later cancellation/returns/credits update the same original cohort; not a new sale-date cohort.
